column5: Forfeited presale deposits flow to the DEVELOPER, not the construction lender. Developer uses deposits for contractor liens, operating costs, unit discounting. Not a clean 1:1 offset to construction loan paydown. In 2008, 30-50% of contracts in some towers failed to close at original terms. Developers re-marketed at steep discounts or sold blocks to opportunistic funds. 2006-07 typical capital stacks: 60-70% LTC, 70%+ LTV (vs OZK's 46%/39% today). OZK needs >50% price decline to breach — 2008 Miami was 38-42%.
column13: Critical nuance that Gemini's bull case missed. Deposits protect the DEVELOPER, not OZK directly. In stress, deposits get consumed before reaching loan paydown. But OZK's LTC cushion means this only matters in a worse-than-GFC scenario.
